note: Hunger (AUTO14, round 24): the printed Hunger lines a fight cannot run, said plainly so the sheet does not list them as not automated yet.  Hunger is mostly a sphere for between fights: refining a meal, preparing a banquet, keeping Satiety over a long rest.  A fight map has no time for an hour-long ritual, so those are listed here instead of being pretended at the table.

tianxia.talent.hunger.famine_surviving_s.why: Preparing a famine bowl takes a short rest and shares the meal out, so it happens between fights, not in one.

tianxia.talent.hunger.second_stomach_met.why: Keeping one Satiety charge over a short rest, so there is nothing to do inside a fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.imperial_banquet_f.why: A banquet for twelve people takes an hour, and its eight-hour blessings are prepared before the fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.the_last_meal_befo.why: A rite lasting an hour before a story moment (a duel, a tribulation, a last stand); the Last Meal die it grants is the player's to add when the table asks for one.

tianxia.talent.hunger.appetite_seal.why: Marks the impurity pattern on an ingredient when you Taste the Qi, so the next Refine the Meal can correct it: both halves happen while you prepare food, not in a fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.demon_meat_without.why: Softens the Impurity a demon-beast meal costs and hides a cosmetic sign of it: both are about the meal you refine, before the fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.famine_enduring_bo.why: Trade a Satiety charge for one willing creature going without hunger or thirst for a day: a decision about the meal, made while you prepare it.

tianxia.talent.hunger.hunger_sense_merid.why: Adds two more questions to Taste the Qi about what a creature last ate, and what it was made from. The table still answers what it senses; nothing here changes a number in a fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.soul_scent_appetit.why: Adds one more question to Taste the Qi about what a creature spiritually craves. The table answers what it senses; no number in a fight changes.

tianxia.talent.hunger.old_monster_kitche.why: The bonus is for a Refine the Meal made after the table named the dangerous part, which is decided while you cook, not in a fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.all_under_heaven_b.why: Adds a symbolic ingredient to an Imperial Banquet Furnace and a one-rest omen about the region: a narrative and exploration talent, told between fights.

tianxia.talent.hunger.monster_core_simme.why: Spends more Cultivation Points to refine a beast core and remembers which Mantle benefit it will support: both belong to the meal you prepare.

tianxia.talent.hunger.wolfing_the_battle.why: Refines a fresh kill in a minute instead of ten, with a harder Difficulty Class: a change to how long preparing the meal takes.

tianxia.talent.hunger.trail_stomach_scri.why: Lets you refine a meal while travelling and gives one companion a better roll against hunger that day: a travel procedure, not a fight.

tianxia.talent.hunger.feast_after_the_hu.why: Marks a kill as your rightful prey and gives the meal you make from it one extra benefit: the benefit is on the Refine the Meal check, made between fights.

tianxia.talent.hunger.hunter_s_victory_m.why: Makes your next Refine the Meal check on a kill you helped finish easier: the check is made while you prepare the meal.

tianxia.talent.hunger.shared_bowl_method.why: Shares a refined meal with up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures, who each take one benefit until their next long rest.

tianxia.talent.hunger.inner_banquet_furn.why: A banquet furnace built during a short rest and shared with up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures: prepared between fights.
